name: file-box
title: File Box
description: A cardboard file box whose folders lift out by their tabs.
docs:
File Box — A cardboard file box whose folders lift out by their tabs.

The stylesheet sits next to the component and is imported by it, so keep the two together in components/pinui/.

It is set in the system's own UI face, so there is no font to load.

It comes in two themes: pass theme="dark" for the dark one, or wire the prop to your own theme switch.

Its colours are registered as typed CSS custom properties (@property) so a theme change cross-fades; a browser without @property simply switches instantly. Pass fill to have it take its container's whole box, with the scene centred in the largest square that fits.
